Vaduz Football Club is a professional football club from Vaduz, Liechtenstein that plays in the Super League, the top tier of Swiss football. The club plays at the national Rheinpark Stadion, which has a capacity of 5,873 when all are seated but has additional standing places in the North and South ends of the ground, giving a total stadium capacity of 7,838.
